sources.name: OPRA
sources.scope: Official OPRA runtime/database feeds used by the existing app
sources.cursor_strategy: source fingerprint and upstream revision metadata

sources.name: AutoEq
sources.scope: Structured parametric EQ results with measurement and target provenance
sources.cursor_strategy: repository commit and file content hash
sources.license_notes: AutoEq software is MIT licensed, while measurements originate from multiple third-party sources. EQ Library retains measurement/creator provenance and does not treat the software license as blanket permission for raw third-party measurement redistribution.

sources.name: MrChillStorm Headphone Target
sources.scope: Explicitly MIT-licensed author repository with structured headphone/IEM PEQ examples derived from the author's ISO 226:2023 target framework
sources.cursor_strategy: qualified manifest plus GitHub file blob SHA and acoustic fingerprint
sources.license_notes: Repository LICENSE is MIT (copyright 2026 MrChillStorm). Only exact profiles enumerated in config/qualified_github_sources.json are publication-eligible. EQ Library presents these as creator/community tunings and does not endorse source claims about target superiority or scientific validity.

sources.name: Fairbuds by Juraj Fiala
sources.scope: Exact hand-authored Fairphone Fairbuds PEQ records from jurf/fairbuds; third-party-measurement-derived AutoEq outputs in the same repository are excluded
sources.cursor_strategy: qualified manifest plus GitHub file blob SHA and acoustic fingerprint
sources.license_notes: The public jurf/fairbuds repository is identified by GitHub as MIT licensed. Publication is restricted to explicitly qualified files with repository history supporting author-origin. presets/main-ish.txt was refined by repository author Juraj Fiala by hand (commit 66cf13ae87429315e4c1d709d5c327c39e074e85). Presets generated from RTINGS, SoundGuys, DHRME or other third-party measurement inputs are not qualified by this source entry.

sources.name: oratory1990
sources.scope: Direct creator provenance and update discovery for author-created EQ presets; structured filter values continue to arrive through separately qualified sources such as OPRA unless redistribution permission is explicit
sources.cursor_strategy: creator update timestamp/source URL plus acoustic fingerprint of the qualified structured carrier
sources.license_notes: Direct creator pages/PDFs are used for attribution and update discovery only. EQ Library does not infer blanket redistribution permission from public availability. OPRA-carried structured presets may be enriched with direct creator provenance without duplicating the tuning. AutoEq results derived from oratory1990 measurements remain AutoEq-created results, not oratory-authored presets.

sources.name: Squiglink-compatible sources
sources.scope: Public structured measurement/target data where source terms permit use
sources.license_notes: Squiglink server/tooling is permissively licensed, but hosted measurement/database rights can be creator-specific. The v0.3 adapter discovers structured metadata only and never makes measurement records publication-eligible until source-specific rights and attribution are qualified.

sources.name: Reddit audio communities
sources.scope: Public structured PEQ posts and original preset links

sources.name: Head-Fi
sources.scope: Public headphone/model EQ discussions containing structured PEQ settings

sources.name: Audio Science Review
sources.scope: Public headphone/IEM threads with structured PEQ settings

sources.name: The HEADPHONE Community
sources.scope: Public creator/community EQ discussions with original attribution

sources.name: Public GitHub repositories and Gists
sources.scope: Licensed structured EQ datasets and original preset repositories
sources.cursor_strategy: repository commit SHA and file content hash
sources.license_notes: Discovery emits review-only candidates. A matching public file is never published until originality, repository/file licensing, creator attribution, headphone identity, parse validity and canonical dedupe are qualified.

sources.name: Topping Community
sources.scope: Public official and community tuning resources where terms allow
